title: Formal core
description: One mathematical structure and its bindings in each field. The core is the shared language; a binding is one field's dialect.

id.description: Stable ID (R12). Never reused; retire instead.

ma_node.description: Mathematics map node that owns the structure, e.g. MSC:35Kxx. MA owns every theorem.

structure.description: The structure in one sentence, free of any field's vocabulary.

roles.description: Role id -> what the role is.

assumptions.description: Hypotheses of the guarantee, one checkable statement each (R5).

guarantee.description: What follows when every assumption holds.

cell.description: Owning cell, or the field code when no cell is recorded.

tool.description: The field's own name for the technique.

maturity.description: standard = textbook use in the field; specialist = used by a subfield; speculative = proposed, not established.

roles.description: Role id -> what plays it in this field.

assumptions_met.description: Assumption id -> y (normally met), ~ (approximately), n (normally violated), ? (not known).

breaks.description: Where the analogy fails in this field. Required: a binding with no stated limit is not accepted.
